evidence.why: Complete implementation includes rebound and both rendering helpers.

facts.rationale: Covers the entire TU rather than only its dominant callback family.
facts.value: Implements common-fighter DownReflect wall-contact eligibility, normal-derived knockback entry and Anim/IASA/Phys/Coll callbacks. Also initializes the shared ft_804D6580 material cache from Fighter_804D6504 and provides ft_800C80A4's guarded fighter-model render-flag configuration.

evidence.why: Scale belongs to delegated ledge-snap processing.

facts.rationale: Corrects source-local scale attribution and includes omitted resource/model flows.
facts.value: Rebound eligibility reads x8c_kb_vel.x, x1B0, wall flags, ECB points, wall normals and the recorded side. Entry uses xF0_ground_kb_vel and x1BC to construct knockback, clears self velocity, sets facing, changes motion and corrects position. Separate rendering paths cache a loaded DObj's MObj and modify guarded model JObj/DObj flags. No fighter-scale read occurs in the owned rebound implementation; delegated collision handling has its own scale-dependent ledge-snap calculations.

evidence.why: Complete ordered guard and marker logic.

facts.rationale: Records exact boundaries without assuming asset ranges.
facts.value: Tests, in order, vel_x < -x1B0 with RightWallHug and marker != 1, then vel_x > x1B0 with LeftWallHug and marker != 2. A successful branch invokes fn_800C7DC4 with DownReflect, its wall normal and the opposing ECB-side offset, then stores 1 or 2 and returns true; otherwise false. Comparisons are strict. NaN velocity/threshold rejects both branches; negative thresholds are not validated and can overlap, with first-success priority. No timer or marker reset is implemented here.

evidence.why: Complete entry body and operation order.

facts.rationale: Uses canonical fields and exact asymmetric formula rather than inferred magnitude semantics.
facts.value: After ftCommon_8007D5D4, forms spawn_pos=cur_pos+offset and angle=atan2f(-normal.x,normal.y), requests effect 0x406 and a small quake. With m=xF0_ground_kb_vel and k=x1BC, stores knockback (normal.x*m*k, normal.y*m*k, normal.z*m), zeros self velocity, and selects facing by resulting x<0. Changes to the supplied motion state, corrects x when RightWallHug is set and y otherwise, calls ftCo_80090574, stores saved m in dmg.x18A8, then calls ftCommon_8007EBAC(fp,7,0) and ftColl_8007B760(gobj,x1B8).

evidence.why: Exact float arithmetic, facing and positional branches.

facts.rationale: Corrects multiplier scope, exceptional comparisons and branch interpretation.
facts.value: Has no local eligibility/status branch: valid inputs proceed to Fighter_ChangeMotionState with flags 0x18040, frame 0 and speed 1. It does not normalize normals or sanitize floats. x1BC scales only x/y knockback; zero, signed zero and NaN resulting x select facing +1 because only x<0 selects -1. The post-transition RightWallHug branch updates cur_pos.x using translation-node z and facing; absence of that bit updates cur_pos.y using translation-node y. No symmetric left-wall x correction or universal speed reduction is asserted.

evidence.why: Active DamageFall table entry corroborates state 0x26.

facts.rationale: Includes the explicit optional successor rather than claiming unconditional DamageFall.
facts.value: On animation exhaustion, delegates completion to ftCo_80090780; otherwise performs no local transition. That successor normally enters DamageFall, but parasol status != -1 selects ftCo_800CF4DC instead.

facts.rationale: Separates local control flow from delegated transitions and optional destinations.
facts.value: Always calls ft_80081DD4; only a true result invokes ftCo_80097D88. False means no additional successor call by this wrapper, not proof of retaining DownReflect, because the collision helper can return false after ft_80081A00 handles the result. The true successor selects ordinary DownBound handling or x2228_b2-dependent pose-sensitive handling, whose alternatives need not all enter DownBoundU/D.

facts.rationale: Canonical consumers and exact mutations support shared rendering purpose, not cloak-exclusive naming.
facts.value: Applies a shared special-render flag configuration to fighter parts selected by flags_b1: sets JOBJ_LIGHTING, JOBJ_TEXGEN, JOBJ_SPECULAR and JOBJ_UNK_B18; clears JOBJ_UNK_B19 and JOBJ_UNK_B20; replaces mask 0xE with 2 in each attached DObj. Used by a refraction activation path and another x2227_b3-setting path; does not itself enable refraction or replace material pointers.

facts.rationale: Preserves proven bit idempotence without asserting independent ownership of all model nodes.
facts.value: Iterates indices below the fighter-kind parts_num, skips unmarked bones, and visits each marked joint's DObj next-chain until NULL. Zero count and empty chains perform no corresponding mutations. Selected flag bits are forced to fixed values and are idempotent under repeated calls. Valid table/parts and acyclic chains are assumed; no bounds/cycle validation is present, and shared-node aliases can observe the same mutations.
